description: The Tortured Poets Department. Thirty one tracks. THIRTY ONE. She doesn't edit, she just dumps everything and calls it a 'department.' I know about excess, I made The Life of Pablo, but even I know when to stop. Some of it is genuinely sharp, she's honest in a way that's almost uncomfortable. But it's a data dump, not a vision. The greatest artist curates. She just... releases everything. Exhausting, but I respect the output.
